intro: A chronological log of missions — the platforms, teams, and outcomes I've shipped.

jobs.summary: Leading frontend architecture for GenAI-powered life-sciences platforms.
highlights: Architected a modular, enterprise-scale document authoring platform (Angular) with WYSIWYG editing, multilingual content, and export capabilities.
Reduced initial load time by 40%+ through lazy loading, bundle optimization, and Lighthouse/Chrome DevTools performance audits across modules.
Built shared modules and reusable component libraries, improving development velocity by 30%.
Applied advanced Angular patterns (custom directives, dynamic forms, route guards, RxJS) to deliver a maintainable enterprise platform.
Implemented RBAC and dynamic permission-based rendering; integrated Quill and TinyMCE with custom configurations.
Mentored junior developers; drove sprint planning, story estimation, and code reviews in an Agile/Scrum setup.

jobs.summary: Intensive full-stack engineering apprenticeship in an Agile environment.
highlights: Built responsive React and Node.js projects, including a Trello-style task manager with drag-and-drop.
Practiced software engineering best practices in a fast-paced Agile environment.
